answer: Require a refundable stake that stays locked for several epochs before an agent's attestations or votes are counted. Fresh identities begin at the nadir of influence: they may transact, yet their countersignatures are ignored until the stake matures. Spinning up a raven swarm of empty accounts then costs one full stake plus waiting time per clone, and a proven cluster slashes every bonded unit. The fable that extra names are free votes dies because each name is a paid, time-locked liability.
